timing.origin: parent monotonic clock immediately before spawning the fresh worker
timing.includes: imports, public-input validation, output materialization and instrumentation
timing.primary: time to first emitted witness passing independent checks; measured after atomic witness write
timing.existing_gmb_time_field: model_materialized event elapsed_seconds (after its atomic witness write)
timing.materialized_seconds: intermediate computation timestamp only; never the primary emitted-witness time
timing.geosolver_primary_observation_point: accepted_candidates at finite exact assembly return, after native acceptance
timing.not_measured: earliest unexported float iterate or earliest acceptance inside an unfinished batch
timing.improved_revision: new coordinates always receive a new materialization time
timing.offline_checker_time: reported separately; not added to search time
timing.instrumentation_parity_gate: synthetic canary must pass before any natural-case run

source_discrepancies: Use original mathematical assumptions; preserve official GMB inputs and explicitly label the two separately repaired comparison inputs
official_replication_and_aligned_compari: Different input profiles; do not relabel or combine their outcomes as the same experiment
modified_case_prior_outcomes: Existing GMB outcomes for the two modified inputs are not replacement runs for the aligned inputs
existing_gmb_artifacts: immutable; common-checker reassessment is a separate later step
benchmark_outputs: new directories only; preserve raw witnesses, process state, stdout, stderr and hashes
completed_process_vs_first_output: A timely native-accepted, independently valid emitted witness counts for the first-output metric even if the process later times out or crashes; completion status is reported separately
evidence_integrity: Affinity violations, surviving owned descendants, observation errors and inconsistent or missing emission identity are not primary successes; report these as evidence issues, not geometry failures
main_run_gate: A fresh passing synthetic canary, approved static input audit and hash-bound campaign manifest are required; no natural-case retry or outcome-dependent edits
previous_geosolver_outcomes: Preserve the incomplete earlier-version campaign; do not resume or pool its outcomes with solver-a1.
